event: each wand shot
done_when: SW_WandBolt_00..02 pass --scan; SC_WandBolt in the dump with SCON_WandBolt and random no-repeat

event: amber clock flash starts
done_when: --log telegraph line for OwlBolt with lead >= 0.2 s

event: each owl projectile spawns
done_when: SC_OwlBoltLaunch in the dump with SCON_Launch

event: wing pose and flow lines start
done_when: --log telegraph line for Gust with lead >= 0.2 s

event: gust zone active; volume follows gust strength (gust_param 0-1)
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; looping set only on this asset; --log gust_param changes in every gust

event: red arc trail starts
done_when: --log telegraph line for Arc with lead >= 0.2 s

event: wand bolt hits the owl body
done_when: SW_HitOwl_00..02 pass --scan; random no-repeat in the dump; told apart from HitClock and HitWing in --blind-id

event: wand bolt hits the chest clock (briefly disrupts an attack)
done_when: named by every player in the blind ID test (--blind-id)

event: wand bolt hits a wing (weakens future gusts)
done_when: SC_HitWing in the dump with SCON_Hit; in the --blind-id set

event: player takes one bolt hit (34 HP)
done_when: named by every player in the blind ID test (--blind-id)

event: front shield absorbs an owl bolt (CatchSucceeded; also during the heal cooldown)
done_when: SC_ShieldCatch in the dump with SCON_State; told apart from ShieldHeal and PlayerHurt in --blind-id

event: a catch heals 20 HP (heal cooldown ready; never on a cooldown catch)
done_when: SC_ShieldHeal in the dump with SCON_State; told apart from ShieldCatch in --blind-id

event: umbrella moves down a tier (intact damaged critical)
done_when: named by every player in the blind ID test (--blind-id)

event: umbrella opens
done_when: plays on every open in the arena map

event: umbrella closes
done_when: plays on every close in the arena map

event: owl pauses and departs
done_when: --log end_event then duck line

event: phase changes (only when the encounter uses phase presets; same sound every run)
done_when: UmbrellaElla.Owl.World.PhaseChangePlaysCue passes: 2 plays of SC_PhaseChime

event: Survived end card shows
done_when: plays once on the end card

event: pause or retry selected
done_when: plays on menu select

event: timer 0%
done_when: --log stem line at t_norm 0.00 layered=1 start=bar|fade

event: timer 25%
done_when: --log stem line at t_norm 0.25 layered=1 start=bar|fade

event: timer 70%
done_when: --log stem line at t_norm 0.70 layered=1 start=bar|fade

event: fire held to charge a shot (only if the PC shooting scheme is picked)
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; looping set only on this asset

event: charged shot fires
done_when: SC_ChargeRelease in the dump with SCON_WandBolt

event: umbrella moves up a tier while closed to repair it (only if repair is picked)
done_when: SC_UmbrellaRepair in the dump with SCON_State; told apart from UmbrellaTear in --blind-id

event: the player enters the safe wind zone (WindEntered)
done_when: SC_GustCatch in the dump with SCON_State; plays on every WindEntered in the arena map

event: the owl's condition drops a step
done_when: SC_OwlGearSlip in the dump with SCON_State

event: fail card shows (health 0 or bottom crossing)
done_when: plays once on the fail card

event: health in the critical stage (1-33 HP)
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; stops when health leaves the critical stage

event: umbrella shows the critical wear stage
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; looping set only on this asset

event: menu focus moves to another button or row
done_when: SC_UiMove in the dump with SCON_UI; audio_loop close PASS for UiMove

event: Back closes the current screen
done_when: SC_UiBack in the dump with SCON_UI; audio_loop close PASS for UiBack

event: a menu screen opens (title or settings)
done_when: SC_UiOpen in the dump with SCON_UI; audio_loop close PASS for UiOpen

event: a menu screen closes without Back (Resume or Play)
done_when: SC_UiClose in the dump with SCON_UI; audio_loop close PASS for UiClose

event: a settings value steps (each slider or option step)
done_when: SC_UiSliderTick in the dump with SCON_UI; audio_loop close PASS for UiSliderTick

event: a full-screen transition (title to play or end card to restart)
done_when: SC_UiTransition in the dump with SCON_UI; audio_loop close PASS for UiTransition

event: pause opens (Esc or P or Options)
done_when: SC_PauseIn in the dump with SCON_UI; audio_loop close PASS for PauseIn

event: pause closes and play resumes
done_when: SC_PauseOut in the dump with SCON_UI; audio_loop close PASS for PauseOut

event: title screen shows
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; audio_loop close PASS for MusicTitle

gdd: GDD 1.3 §8 READY to ACTIVE; §9 explicit start
event: the encounter turns ACTIVE
done_when: SC_EncounterStart in the dump with SCON_State; audio_loop close PASS for EncounterStart

event: retry starts RESTARTING
done_when: SC_Restart in the dump with SCON_State; audio_loop close PASS for Restart

event: PlayerDefeated (health 0 or bottom crossing) before the fail card
done_when: SC_PlayerDefeat in the dump with SCON_Hit; audio_loop close PASS for EllaDown

event: always on in the arena under the music
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; audio_loop close PASS for WindBed

event: the player is inside the safe wind current (WindEntered to WindExited)
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; audio_loop close PASS for WindZoneLoop

event: the player leaves the safe wind current (WindExited)
done_when: SC_WindExit in the dump with SCON_State; audio_loop close PASS for WindExit

event: the owl gust zone turns off
done_when: SC_GustEnd in the dump with SCON_State; audio_loop close PASS for GustEnd

event: canopy flutter while UP_OPEN has lift (LiftAvailabilityChanged)
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; audio_loop close PASS for UmbrellaFlap

event: umbrella turns to the front shield (SHIELD_DESCENT entered)
done_when: SC_ShieldRaise in the dump with SCON_State; audio_loop close PASS for ShieldRaise

event: air rush while falling; volume follows fall speed
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; audio_loop close PASS for EllaFallLoop

gdd: GDD 1.3 §7 side and top bounds CORE-01
event: Ella meets a side or top arena bound
done_when: SC_EllaBump in the dump with SCON_State; audio_loop close PASS for EllaBump

event: owl wingbeats while it hovers
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; audio_loop close PASS for OwlWingLoop

event: an owl bolt is in flight
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; audio_loop close PASS for OwlBoltTravelLoop

event: an owl bolt despawns without a contact (lifetime or bounds)
done_when: SC_OwlBoltFade in the dump with SCON_Launch; audio_loop close PASS for OwlBoltFade

event: the owl chest clock ticks while the encounter is ACTIVE
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; audio_loop close PASS for ClockTickLoop

event: a wand bolt expires or leaves the arena
done_when: SC_WandBoltFade in the dump with SCON_WandBolt; audio_loop close PASS for WandBoltFade

event: a wand bolt is in flight
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; audio_loop close PASS for WandBoltTravelLoop

event: the returning arc spawns
done_when: SC_ArcLaunch in the dump with SCON_Launch; audio_loop close PASS for ArcLaunch

event: the returning arc is in flight
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; audio_loop close PASS for ArcTravelLoop

event: the returning arc despawns without a contact
done_when: SC_ArcFade in the dump with SCON_Launch; audio_loop close PASS for ArcFade

event: always on in the arena: far bells and clockwork room tone
done_when: loop wrap passes --scan; audio_loop close PASS for BelfryAmbience
